runtime_bridge::vendor::Session

pub unsafe fn attach(api: Api) -> Self


Register callback context for a vendor device.

Safetyapi must come from the supported vendor runtime, remain loaded for the session lifetime, and must not unwind. Use one Session per device and call its methods only on the registration thread. The token represents callback context, and the vendor is allowed to read it while the session is active.
